# rustinion_monitor_macro_override (Resource)

Sets a monitoring-template macro on a device, a group, or (neither set) the whole organization. Device beats group beats organization beats the templates' defaults.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `macro` (String)
- `value` (String)

### Optional

- `context` (String)
- `device_id` (String)
- `group_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
